## 0.6.0

### Added
- Bundle the official GSAP skill family (8 skills): gsap-core, gsap-timeline, gsap-scrolltrigger, gsap-plugins, gsap-utils, gsap-react, gsap-performance, gsap-frameworks. The kit now ships 23 skills.

### Updated
- Synced upstream skill bundles (a11y-audit, better-* family) to latest.
